topic: The operator should not be the integration layer
caption:
Your commerce stack does not usually fail in one dramatic moment. It drifts.

One channel has the latest stock. Another has the customer promise. A marketplace has the return status. Finance has the payout question. Suddenly, the operator becomes the integration layer.

Sanocea uses AI to prepare that work before it becomes another meeting: classify the issue, attach evidence, route the next step and keep human approval where it belongs.

AI operations. Every channel.

Request a diagnostic at sanocea.com
